place: Dīkṣā from the son of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa of Raṅga-kṣetra, who put him in Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's care (Bhakti-ratnākara 9).
Eldest son of Hita Harivaṁśa; served Śrī Rādhāvallabhajī.
A devotee of Lord Caitanya in Orissa, son of Kānāi Khuṇṭiyā (Vaiṣṇava-vandanā).
His own guru is not named; guru of Kṛṣṇadāsa «Kṛṣṇa-kiṅkara» (#2110).
His guru Gopāla dāsa named him Kṛṣṇa-kiṅkara.
